title: Don't forget the Twisted Sister. Yeah
text:
Don't forget the Twisted Sister. Yeah. Man, I really wanted to get this product of 5, but I could only give it A,3 here's why, let me give you a little back story. When I first saw this offered. I was like man this is going to really be cool. I got me some fresh corn. when I got it. I wanted to go out and try it, right. So, I had my wife fix me a special dinner. I wanted it so bad. I made it for lunch Philly Mignon Steaks. Steaks cooked medium just a touch over medium going to medium well, covered with mushrooms and onions sauteed. with spinach and so it's all set. I just take this cob corn stripper and do just like the instruction said. I'm looking at the instructions that was on the side of the box. 4 steps for you. I start pushing it in for about 1.1/2” it was going really good. I was like wow this is cool, but then it stops, so. I turned it around, I start pushing it again I got maybe ½” an inch and I was like wow. I don't think this is working. I went online and I said man OK, you got to twist it. OK, so now I am twisting the rest of corn and still fighting it. I turn it, twisted it to get the kernels and
not too much. I still recommend my friend; you know me I'll recommend once on a strong three. Thank you. God bless you. And may the rest of your life be the best of your life. OZ

product_metadata.title: Cob Corn Stripper, Corn Stripping Tool Manual Corn Threshing for Removing Kernels from Fresh Corn（Yellow)
